fields.name: image
fields.label: Listing image
fields.description: Shown on listing cards and when the page is shared.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Used by Listing blocks as a filter. Reuse the exact same wording on every page of this market, e.g. "Partner Privileges".

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: News: publication date. Listings sort newest first.

fields.name: validfrom
fields.label: Valid from
fields.description: Offers: hidden from listings before this date.

fields.name: validto
fields.label: Valid to
fields.description: Offers: hidden from listings after this date. Must be on or after Valid from.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

options.name: Warm (with Dark: near-black, for the loyalty band)

fields.name: tabLabel
fields.label: Tab label
fields.description: Optional. Makes this section a tab of the nearest Tabs block above it. Keep it short and unique.

options.name: One item open at a time

fields.name: searchLabel
fields.label: Search label
fields.description: FAQ search only. Visible label for the search field, e.g. "Search FAQs". Leave empty to hide the search.

fields.name: noResultsMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: FAQ search only. Shown and announced when a search matches nothing.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Question or title
fields.description: Plain text shown on the clickable row. Keep it unique within the block.

fields.name: origin
fields.label: Origin airport
fields.description: Optional 3-letter IATA code pre-selected as From, e.g. BKK.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use one 3-letter airport code, e.g. BKK.

fields.name: destinations
fields.label: Destination airports
fields.description: Optional comma-separated IATA codes, e.g. TPE, KHH. With "Limit to the listed airports", only these can be chosen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Use 3-letter airport codes separated by commas, e.g. TPE, KHH.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Pick at most one layout (overlay, compact, profile or logos). Feature first card can be combined with any of them.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Required. Avoid text in the image.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt
fields.description: Describes the image. For logos, the partner name. Leave empty only if the image is decorative.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Title (heading or bold), optional description and up to 2 links. With one link the whole card is clickable. Profile: name as title, then the role. Logos: one link named after the partner.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Accessible label
fields.description: Optional. Names the carousel for screen readers, e.g. "Partner offers". If empty, the heading just above the block is used.

fields.name: previousLabel
fields.label: Previous button label
fields.description: Read by screen readers, e.g. "Previous slide". Leave both button labels empty to hide the arrow buttons.

fields.name: nextLabel
fields.label: Next button label
fields.description: Read by screen readers, e.g. "Next slide".

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image alt text
fields.description: Describe the image. Leave empty only if it is purely decorative. Don't rely on text inside the image.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (hero only)
fields.description: Optional portrait crop shown below 600px. Uses the same alt text.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Title (bold or a heading at the right level), description, and optionally one link or button.

fields.name: columns
fields.label: Columns
fields.description: 2 or 3. Columns stack below 900px, image first.

fields.name: rows
fields.label: Rows
fields.description: Each row is a set of columns.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Widths apply to 2 columns. Combine freely.

options.name: Image fills its column edge to edge

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Wide banner image (about 4.8:1). Avoid text in the image; if the image contains text, repeat it in the alt text.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt
fields.description: Describes the image. Leave empty only if the image is purely decorative.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image
fields.description: Optional crop for screens narrower than 600px. Uses the same alt text. If empty, the main image is used.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Page title as Heading 1, an optional subtitle and an optional link. Bold link = primary button, italic link = secondary button.

fields.name: folder
fields.label: Pages under
fields.description: Lists the published pages inside this folder, e.g. the Offers or News folder.

fields.name: categories
fields.label: Only these categories
fields.description: Optional, comma-separated, matching the pages' Category exactly. Empty shows all.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Maximum items
fields.description: Optional. Empty shows every matching page.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Accessible label
fields.description: Optional. Names the tab list for screen readers, e.g. "Baggage by route". If empty, the heading just above the block is used. Tabs come from the following sections that have a Tab label.
